Past offers archive

Every promotion we have run in the current financial year, kept here for reference by customers who want to check what a product cost during a previous sale. Prices listed in this archive are not current and cannot be claimed today. The archive covers kitchen appliances, hand tools, outdoor furniture and seasonal decorations, and each entry records the discount percentage that applied at the time along with the dates the promotion was live in stores and online. Customers occasionally ask us to honour an archived price; we cannot do that, but the record is kept public so the history of a product's pricing is at least visible.

See the current catalog for prices that are live today, or the blender product page for a worked example of how the current price and the archived price differ.
